'''FK Borac Šamac''' ([[Serbian Cyrillic]]: ФК Борац Шaмaц) is a professional [[football (soccer)|football]] club from the town of [[Šamac, Bosnia and Herzegovina|Šamac]], in northern [[Bosnia and Herzegovina]]. The club competes in the [[Second League of the Republika Srpska]] (Group West)."}}
